guards.name: js-b2-node-guard
guards.limitation: No final guard receipt: wall time and peak RSS are unknown; not counted and not estimated.

limits: Measured guard wall seconds include failures with final receipts; they are not total research wall time, CPU-seconds, or agent cost.
Unknown Node interruption is explicitly excluded; no elapsed-time or peak-RSS estimate is inferred from note timestamps.
The final-validation category is separate from earlier validation and investigation. Native bootstrap acquisition includes its internal generation checks; its outer guard is counted once.
Archive maintenance, editing, analysis, idle gaps and external jobs are not included. Missing timing means observed totals are a lower bound, even after phase completion.
